body.name: branchmap
body.construction: For every \(\xi\in\Xi\), compute \(\mathfrak B(\xi)\) and every certificate slack \(G_b(\xi)\); return the unique \(b\) with \(G_b(\xi)>0\) when it exists, and return \(\bot\) when the certified set is empty, more than one branch passes, or a global-objective tie has zero slack
